name: outlook
description: New mail in your Outlook or Microsoft 365 inbox, read through Microsoft Graph with read-only permission. It cannot mark as read, move, delete or send.

requires.help: Register an application of your own at https://entra.microsoft.com (App registrations, New registration), switch on "Allow public client flows" under Authentication, give it the delegated Microsoft Graph permissions Mail.Read and offline_access only, and save its Application (client) ID in that file as { "clientId": "...", "tenant": "common" }. Steps: extractors/outlook/README.md. A work mailbox usually needs an administrator to allow the app, and it is your employer's decision whether work mail may be copied to this machine.

connect.note: You will be shown an address and a short code. Open the address in your browser, enter the code, sign in and approve read-only access to your mail.
